text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
They're crossing the 600-meter mark!! Now, 
how will Mr. C.B. make her move—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(—Damn it! As I thought, this is 
brutal...! My head and body are screaming 
at me...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Still, tch――like I give a damn...! Limits 
are meant to be...!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Heh—!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAHH!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. is so strong!! Just 100 meters to 
go—will she become the Kikuka Sho 
Umamusume?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. crosses the finish line in first 
place!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOH!! YEAAAAHHH!! C.B. is the 
'strongest' Umamusume there isーー!!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
What was with that downhill running...!? 
That race was seriously amazing...!!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
――Ace-san. I have truly borne witness to 
your battle...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Damn it...!! Dammit, dammit all...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(How pathetic...! After deciding I'd 
definitely win, to give such a 
half-baked—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Don't you go losing, dammit...!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —You're serious, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ace is always genuinely frustrated 
whenever she loses.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Kh, C.B....! Of course I will, that's a 
given—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: It's not that obvious.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Out of anyone I've seen up to today, you 
were the one who felt that frustration 
most deeply for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That's because you ran with a stronger 
desire to 'beat me' than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Because they gave me a true "race."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Because you're you... today's match was 
intensely thrilling as well.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Our best-of-three series is over now, 
but... We definitely have to race together 
again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
…………Yeah. I will definitely race against 
you again...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll get stronger, even, even stronger! 
Next time, I'll definitely beat you!!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Nice. It's glaring at its absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—I'll be looking forward to next time, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning to the waiting room with 
Katsuragi Ace after the fierce battle—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: Ace-chan, great run in the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, both of you...! You came all the way 
to Kyoto just to watch me! Thank you so 
much...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! Today's race was close, 
but... it was so thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Ace-chan, seeing you never give up during 
your run was so cool again today...! It 
made all of us want to fight just like 
that!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: ...Frejus-san thinks so too, right~?

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: ...Good work, Ace-san.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
We bumped into each other on the way 
here... and when I heard Frejus was also 
cheering for Ace-chan, we came together.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Fréjus...!! You came to watch...!!!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"...Your run, defying all conventional 
wisdom— I bore witness to every second of 
it. Truly... wonderful work out there."

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
...I think I will take some time to 
reflect upon myself.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: Someday...... so that we can fight again.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much for today.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Fréjus-san left—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...It's fine. I heard plenty from them.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"...Ace-chan. Thank you so much from all 
of us too. ...For always fighting right at 
the very front."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you looking so cool out there, 
Es-cchi, gives us the strength to keep our 
chins up...! Thank you! You're our true 
"Ace"!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'm the one... who should be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Throughout this three-match showdown... 
the hopes everyone entrusted to me became 
the power that pushed me forward, time and 
time again—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Thank you... for cheerin' me on!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, tell me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What do you think I need to do... to stand 
on equal footing with CB?
choice_data_list:
...I definitely don't think you're 
inferior in any way.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks. But, you know, even if you say 
that, Trainer... the people watching our 
races feel differently.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, what everyone wants to see and 
expects the most is for CB to win. ...Me 
and the other Umamusume are just side 
dishes.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Even after our three-match clash, in the 
end, I couldn't change these 
"expectations." That's what frustrates 
me... the absolute most...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So think with me, please...!! How can I 
completely overturn the “expectations” of 
this era from the ground up?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh!? S-Seriously!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod in agreement. Because I, too, felt 
the exact same frustration as Katsuragi 
Ace from this best-of-three matchup...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace is by no means an 
afterthought to Mr. C.B. She is her rival, 
and an Umamusume leading at the forefront 
of this era.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If people refuse to see Katsuragi Ace that 
way, then I'll raise her current presence 
so high that they'll have no choice but to 
look at her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—From our battles up to today, I've 
become convinced that Katsuragi Ace excels 
particularly at medium distances. Going 
forward, we should focus all our efforts 
on breaking through with that strength.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Our target is quite simply to be the 
'Undisputed Best at Medium Distance' in 
this era. In other words, earning the 
track record worthy of claiming that 
title...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And for that sake, too—
choice_data_list:
I *will* win both the "Osaka Hai" and the 
"Takarazuka Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Placing in the top isn't enough, simply 
running well won't do. I have to take 1st 
place in both races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Only by doing so can Katsuragi Ace prove 
that she's the 'Strongest at Medium 
Distance'...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
In short, I just gotta make 'em realize 
"Katsuragi Ace is right here!" in middle 
distance, right...! Nice and simple, I 
like it!
choice_data_list:
Even if our opponent is Mr. C.B., we're 
going to win no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Of course! Let's do this, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with the Osaka Hai as the next 
target, our journey to prove we were the 
strongest at medium distance began, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later. Mr. C.B. announced a 
long-term hiatus due to issues with her 
legs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The public couldn't hide their 
disappointment regarding the Twinkle 
Series from winter onward, which would now 
be without Mr. C.B....

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Of all times for C.B. to go on a break, 
man. She says it's nothing major, but 
still—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
......No, this won't do! What good comes 
from letting myself get discouraged...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Think about it the other way! If CB isn't 
here, I just have to show everyone who 
CB's true rival really is while she's 
gone!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(And when that guy comes back... I'll 
surpass him standing on completely equal 
footing in everyone's eyes!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
First up is next year's Osaka Hai! I am 
definitely... going to win!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the Classic Year reaches a major 
milestone, time marches forward toward the 
next grand stage of the Senior Year, the 
Osaka Hai—
